slides.headline: 1:20 PM: "Call tonight". 11:41 PM: "Tomorrow".
slides.body: And tomorrow is already midweek. Your evening is on hold again.
slides.animal_metaphor: Sharp-eyed black cat near a cooling cup of tea — intuition sensing the recurring delay trap.

slides.headline: You keep your evening open
slides.body: You turn down plans and wait for the call. Near midnight, you're left feeling pushed aside once again.
slides.animal_metaphor: Loyal dog waiting beside a dark phone screen — the exhausting emotional holding pattern.

slides.headline: Mistake: "No worries, get some rest"
slides.body: You hide your frustration behind understanding, teaching him that your time has zero value.
slides.animal_metaphor: Dog with head lowered at a closed door — accommodating behavior at your own expense.

slides.headline: The 24-Hour Postponement Loop
slides.body: A tiny daytime promise buys 12 hours of your patience and loyalty with zero effort on his part.
slides.animal_metaphor: Black cat watching clock hands tick — spotting the subtle pattern of low-effort control.

slides.headline: Late-Night Reschedule Decoder
slides.body:
• "Drained today, tomorrow 100%" → No capacity for depth, but wants to keep you on reserve.
• "Let's talk soon" → Easing his immediate guilt.

slides.headline: 3 Signs of Chronic Delay
slides.body:
1. The message arrives past 11 PM.
2. No specific replacement time is set.
3. The loop repeats for the second time this week.
slides.animal_metaphor: Owl in the night shadows against neon clock glow — clear-eyed vision cutting through excuses.

slides.headline: Your schedule is not a waiting room
slides.body: When a call drops at the last minute, your evening isn't lost. It belongs right back to you.
slides.animal_metaphor: Cat stepping away from the empty chair — reclaiming personal time and healthy boundaries.

slides.headline: The Golden Midweek Rule
slides.body: A man who wants connection makes specific time. A man who doubts feeds you with "tomorrow".
slides.animal_metaphor: Owl holding the Today Tarot medallion — final clarity and stepping out of illusions.
